org-replay-alpha.description: Single-org replay profile for the production Chat pipeline. One active agent with one healthy agentmail connection (send+reply enabled, read disabled). No credentials values are stored here; Stage 4 provisions a throwaway agentmail credential through the real credentials flow.

users.mfa: either (ARBYTER_REQUIRE_MFA=false locally, or owner with active AAL2)
not enrolled (member never reaches the MFA gate)

agent_identities.note: identity.verified exists in agent_identities but the production discovery path never consults it; selection therefore never uses it today

credentials.note: agentmail credential for connection c1000000-...-0001 is provisioned via POST /api/agents/credentials (owner-only) during Stage 4 setup and stored in Supabase Vault. Values never appear in dataset files.

provisioning_notes: Create org + users via auth.users insert; handle_new_user trigger provisions public.users with role owner for the first user; set member role explicitly.
Insert ai_agents and agent_connections rows with the fixed IDs above.
Seed governance_policies / governance_policy_rules per-example from the example's stage 4 rules array (enabled, active, effective now).
Runtime-generated IDs (executions, governance decisions, approvals) are created by the pipeline and must not be preset.
